claims.detail: Simulator critic claim: forged ADR pointers erode audit trails unless hashes bind citations to repository commits.

findings.description: Citation forgery undermines trust when URLs fail repository resolution checks during automated pre-merge scans.
findings.recommendation: Force checksum bundles for every external reference before architecture boards ratify the packet.

findings.description: Compliance reviewers need verified ADR mappings so regulated workloads inherit accurate control inheritance stories.
findings.recommendation: Run the signing workflow that verifies repository commits against published ADR identifiers nightly.
